resources.string: Your character joins your everyday life
Create a character with the look and personality you want
Your character\'s state changes with workouts, sleep, and steps
It\'s with you on your Apple Watch face and main screen too
Your steps, workouts, and sleep are reflected in your character\'s state.
When you start a workout, your character works out with you
Your character sleeps while you sleep
Without permission, it only goes by the time of day
Even if you allow it, your data is processed only on your device.
Gets the weather at your location and reflects it in the background.
The background changes with rain, snow, sunshine, and night
Location is only used on your device and never stored on our servers
Without permission, only the character shows, with no background
Get notified when you hit your step goal, it\'s bedtime, or a workout ends.
We only send a few a day so it\'s not disruptive
All the main features work even if you don\'t allow this
Detects Sleep Focus mode and puts your character to sleep.
For better accuracy, connect withu to your Focus and Sleep filters in Settings
You can see how to connect again in the main screen settings
Without permission, only the sleep times in your profile are used
You can turn this on later in Settings
Permissions you skipped can be turned on later in settings on the main screen.
Create a character and it\'ll reflect your day.
Use \'Batch Create\' to make several states of one character at once, or \'Single\' to make them one at a time. Add a reference photo and we\'ll keep that look when drawing.

When you \'Apply\' a creation, that character shows up on your home screen, widget, and Apple Watch to match your current state (sleeping, walking, eating, etc.). You can also apply it everywhere at once with \'Apply this character to all\' in the gallery\'s \'By character\' tab.
Press and hold your Home or Lock Screen to add a widget, and your character plus info like steps and sleep will show up in it.

Long-press your watch face, tap Edit, and add withu to a complication slot to see your character on the watch face. Workouts like walks and runs are detected by your Apple Watch (heart rate) when connected, or by your iPhone\'s motion when there\'s no watch.
Creating a character uses candies — 1 per image, 2 for an animated character. Top up candies in the shop.
